```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  sesoi_prop = params$sesoi_prop,
  top_prop_main = params$top_prop_main,
  top_exact_n_for_plots = params$top_exact_n_for_plots,

safe_q <- function(x, p) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
}

public_table_names <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) return(x)
  nm <- names(x)
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "parent_n_ecg_leads", "parent_n_ecg_channels")
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "n_ecg_leads", "n_ecg_channels")
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "ecg_leads", "ecg_channels")
  names(x) <- nm
  x
}

save_table <- function(x, name, csv = TRUE) {
  rds_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(x, rds_file)
  csv_file <- NA_character_
  if (csv) {
    csv_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".csv"))
    utils::write.csv(public_table_names(x), csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  tibble(
    name = name,
    rds = rds_file,
    csv = csv_file,
    n_rows = ifelse(is.data.frame(x), nrow(x), NA_integer_)
  )
}

kable_clean <- function(x, digits = 2, ...) {
  knitr::kable(public_table_names(x), digits = digits, ...)
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, name, width = 8, height = 5) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$save_figures)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".png")), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}

n_top_prop <- function(n_available, prop = settings$top_prop_main) {
  max(1L, ceiling(prop * n_available))
}

make_combo_uid <- function(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads) {
  paste(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, sep = "__")
}

assign_anatomical_family_exclusive <- function(
    n_total,
    n_V,
    n_upper_vascular,
    n_standard_limb,
    contains_V,
    contains_upper_vascular,
    contains_standard_limb
) {
  n_classified <- n_V + n_upper_vascular + n_standard_limb
  family_key <- paste0(
    ifelse(contains_V, "V", ""),
    ifelse(contains_upper_vascular, "U", ""),
    ifelse(contains_standard_limb, "L", "")
  )
  
  case_when(
    is.na(n_total) | n_total == 0 ~ NA_character_,
    n_classified != n_total ~ NA_character_,
    family_key == "V" ~ "all V/precordial",
    family_key == "U" ~ "all neck/supraclavicular",
    family_key == "L" ~ "all limb anchors",
    family_key == "VL" ~ "V + limb",
    family_key == "VU" ~ "V + neck/supraclavicular",
    family_key == "UL" ~ "neck/supraclavicular + limb",
    family_key == "VUL" ~ "V + neck/supraclavicular + limb",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```

# Analysis logic

Part 3 treats reduced ECG-channel montage selection as a **non-inferiority problem** relative to the best full 15-channel CCA result.

For each participant × EEG channel:

1. The full 15-channel reference is the minimum residual R-peak prominence across full-montage CCA cleaning levels.
2. Each reduced 1-, 2-, 3-, 4-, and 5-channel ECG combination is evaluated at its own best cleaning level.
3. The loss relative to full 15 is
   \[
   \Delta_{\mathrm{full15}} = Rpeak_{reduced,best} - Rpeak_{full15,best}.
   \]
4. A reduced combination is classified as **not meaningfully worse than full 15** when
   \[
   \Delta_{\mathrm{full15}} \leq SESOI,
   \]
   where SESOI is `r params$sesoi_prop * 100`% of the no-cleaning R-peak value for that participant × EEG channel.

Important implementation choices in this file:

- Main exact-combination rankings are participant-balanced: first compute `% EEG channels as good as full 15` within each participant, then summarize across participants.
- Main bar plots show only `r params$top_exact_n_for_plots` exact combinations per ECG-channel count, but all recurrence and stability summaries use the top `r params$top_prop_main * 100`% pool.
- Therefore, the actual number of top combinations depends on ECG-channel count: `ceiling(top_prop * choose(15, n_channels))`.
- Anatomical families are applied only after exact combinations are ranked.

# Load or recompute reduced-combination scores

```{r load-or-recompute-scored-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
recompute_combination_scores <- function() {
  methods_keep <- settings$methods_keep
  sesoi_prop <- settings$sesoi_prop
  
  chlabels_data1 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels.mat")
  chlabels_data2 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels_data2.mat")
  
  n_data1 <- length(chlabels_data1)
  n_data2 <- length(chlabels_data2)
  participant_levels <- sprintf("P%02d", seq_len(n_data1 + n_data2))
  
  file_plan_data1 <- tribble(
    ~n_ecg_leads, ~file,
    1L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
    2L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
    3L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
    4L, "combinationsdata_4.mat",
    5L, "combinationsdata_5.mat"
  )
  
  file_plan_data2 <- tibble(
    n_ecg_leads = 1:5,
    file = sprintf("combinationsdata2_%d.mat", n_ecg_leads)
  )
  
  df_full15_data1 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset = "data1",
    offset = 0,
    methods = methods_keep,
    measure = "rpeak",
    value_name = "rpeak"
  )
  
  df_full15_data2 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats_2.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset = "data2",
    offset = n_data1,
    methods = methods_keep,
    measure = "rpeak",
    value_name = "rpeak"
  )
  
  df_full15 <- bind_rows(df_full15_data1, df_full15_data2) %>%
    mutate(
      participant = factor(participant, levels = participant_levels),
      subID = factor(subID, levels = participant_levels)
    )
  
  rm(df_full15_data1, df_full15_data2)
  gc()
  
  df_comb_data1 <- load_comb_dataset(
    file_plan = file_plan_data1,
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset = "data1",
    offset = 0,
    methods = methods_keep
  )
  
  df_comb_data2 <- load_comb_dataset(
    file_plan = file_plan_data2,
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset = "data2",
    offset = n_data1,
    methods = methods_keep
  )
  
  df_comb_all <- bind_rows(df_comb_data1, df_comb_data2) %>%
    mutate(participant = factor(participant, levels = participant_levels))
  
  rm(df_comb_data1, df_comb_data2)
  gc()
  
  full15_ref <- df_full15 %>%
    filter(method == "CCA") %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
    summarise(
      rpeak_full15_clean1 = mean(rpeak[clean == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
      rpeak_full15_best = min(rpeak, na.rm = TRUE),
      clean_full15_best = clean[which.min(rpeak)][1],
      sesoi_subj_channel = sesoi_prop * abs(rpeak_full15_clean1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(rpeak_full15_clean1),
      is.finite(rpeak_full15_best),
      is.finite(sesoi_subj_channel),
      sesoi_subj_channel > 0
    )
  
  rm(df_full15)
  gc()
  
  comb_best <- df_comb_all %>%
    filter(method == "CCA") %>%
    select(dataset, participant, n_ecg_leads, clean, channel, combination_id, ecg_leads, rpeak) %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, n_ecg_leads, channel, combination_id, ecg_leads) %>%
    summarise(
      best_i = which.min(rpeak)[1],
      rpeak_reduced_best = rpeak[best_i],
      clean_reduced_best = clean[best_i],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-best_i)
  
  rm(df_comb_all)
  gc()
  
  comb_best %>%
    left_join(full15_ref, by = c("dataset", "participant", "channel")) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_vs_full15 = rpeak_reduced_best - rpeak_full15_best,
      delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15 / sesoi_subj_channel,
      delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline = 100 * delta_vs_full15 / abs(rpeak_full15_clean1),
      performs_as_well_as_full15 = delta_vs_full15 <= sesoi_subj_channel,
      practically_same_as_full15 = abs(delta_vs_full15) <= sesoi_subj_channel,
      better_than_full15_by_sesoi = delta_vs_full15 < -sesoi_subj_channel,
      worse_than_full15_by_sesoi = delta_vs_full15 > sesoi_subj_channel,
      performance_class = case_when(
        better_than_full15_by_sesoi ~ "better than full 15 > SESOI",
        practically_same_as_full15 ~ "same as full 15 ± SESOI",
        worse_than_full15_by_sesoi ~ "worse than full 15 > SESOI",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      full15_improvement = rpeak_full15_clean1 - rpeak_full15_best,
      reduced_improvement = rpeak_full15_clean1 - rpeak_reduced_best,
      pct_full15_improvement_recovered = if_else(
        full15_improvement > 0,
        100 * reduced_improvement / full15_improvement,
        NA_real_
      )
    )
}

if (isTRUE(params$recompute_scored_data) || !file.exists(settings$scored_file)) {
  cca_comb_vs_full15 <- recompute_combination_scores()
  saveRDS(cca_comb_vs_full15, settings$scored_file)
} else {
  cca_comb_vs_full15 <- readRDS(settings$scored_file)
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "dataset", "participant", "channel", "n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads",
  "rpeak_full15_clean1", "rpeak_full15_best", "rpeak_reduced_best",
  "clean_full15_best", "clean_reduced_best", "sesoi_subj_channel",
  "delta_vs_full15", "delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units", "delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline",
  "performs_as_well_as_full15", "practically_same_as_full15",
  "better_than_full15_by_sesoi", "worse_than_full15_by_sesoi",
  "full15_improvement", "pct_full15_improvement_recovered"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(cca_comb_vs_full15))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in cca_comb_vs_full15: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

cca_scored_light <- cca_comb_vs_full15 %>%
  filter(n_ecg_leads <= 5) %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = as.character(dataset),
    participant = as.character(participant),
    channel = as.character(channel),
    n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
    combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
    ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
    combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads),
    rpeak_full15_clean1,
    rpeak_full15_best,
    rpeak_reduced_best,
    clean_full15_best,
    clean_reduced_best,
    components_removed_full15_best = clean_full15_best - 1L,
    components_removed_reduced_best = clean_reduced_best - 1L,
    sesoi = sesoi_subj_channel,
    delta_vs_full15,
    loss_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units,
    loss_pct_baseline = delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline,
    performs_as_well = as.logical(performs_as_well_as_full15),
    practically_same = as.logical(practically_same_as_full15),
    better_by_sesoi = as.logical(better_than_full15_by_sesoi),
    worse_by_sesoi = as.logical(worse_than_full15_by_sesoi),
    full15_improvement,
    reduced_improvement = rpeak_full15_clean1 - rpeak_reduced_best,
    pct_full15_improvement_recovered
  )

rm(cca_comb_vs_full15)
gc()

manifest[["00_scored_light"]] <- save_table(cca_scored_light, "00_scored_light", csv = FALSE)
```

# Accounting and ECG-channel-count overview

```{r accounting-and-ECG-channel-count}
analysis_accounting <- list()

analysis_accounting$sample <- cca_scored_light %>%
  distinct(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_datasets = n_distinct(dataset),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    n_unique_eeg_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    median_channels_per_participant = median(table(participant)),
    min_channels_per_participant = min(table(participant)),
    max_channels_per_participant = max(table(participant)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

analysis_accounting$combination_counts <- cca_scored_light %>%
  distinct(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads) %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  summarise(
    n_exact_combinations = n(),
    expected_n_exact_combinations = choose(15, first(n_ecg_leads)),
    top20_pool_n = n_top_prop(n_exact_combinations),
    top20_pool_pct = 100 * top20_pool_n / n_exact_combinations,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ecg_channel_count_overview <- cca_scored_light %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    n_exact_combinations = n_distinct(combination_id),
    top20_pool_n = n_top_prop(n_exact_combinations),
    pct_rows_as_well = 100 * mean(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_rows_better = 100 * mean(better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_rows_same = 100 * mean(practically_same, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_rows_worse = 100 * mean(worse_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.75),
    q90_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_loss_pct_baseline = median(loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_loss_pct_baseline = safe_q(loss_pct_baseline, 0.90),
    median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

manifest[["01_accounting_sample"]] <- save_table(analysis_accounting$sample, "01_accounting_sample")
manifest[["01_combination_counts"]] <- save_table(analysis_accounting$combination_counts, "01_combination_counts")
manifest[["02_ecg_channel_count_overview"]] <- save_table(ecg_channel_count_overview, "02_ecg_channel_count_overview")

kable_clean(analysis_accounting$sample, digits = 2)
kable_clean(analysis_accounting$combination_counts, digits = 2)
kable_clean(ecg_channel_count_overview, digits = 2)
```

# Exact-combination summaries

```{r exact-combination-summaries}
rank_exact_summary <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    arrange(
      n_ecg_leads,
      desc(median_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(mean_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(q25_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(n_participants_ge50_channels),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units,
      median_loss_sesoi_units,
      ecg_leads
    ) %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
    mutate(rank_within_n = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
}

make_exact_participant_summary <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, participant) %>%
    summarise(
      n_channels_available = n_distinct(channel),
      n_channels_as_well = sum(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_channels_as_well = 100 * n_channels_as_well / n_channels_available,
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.75),
      q90_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
      median_loss_pct_baseline = median(loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90_loss_pct_baseline = safe_q(loss_pct_baseline, 0.90),
      median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      participant_pass_25 = pct_channels_as_well >= 25,
      participant_pass_50 = pct_channels_as_well >= 50,
      participant_pass_60 = pct_channels_as_well >= 60,
      participant_pass_75 = pct_channels_as_well >= 75,
      participant_pass_90 = pct_channels_as_well >= 90
    )
}

make_exact_summary_from_participant <- function(participant_summary) {
  participant_summary %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_participants_total = n_distinct(participant),
      mean_pct_channels_as_well = mean(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_channels_as_well = median(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_channels_as_well, 0.25),
      q75_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_channels_as_well, 0.75),
      min_pct_channels_as_well = min(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge25_channels = sum(participant_pass_25, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge50_channels = sum(participant_pass_50, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge60_channels = sum(participant_pass_60, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge75_channels = sum(participant_pass_75, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge90_channels = sum(participant_pass_90, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q75_loss_sesoi_units = median(q75_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_participant_q90_loss_sesoi_units = max(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_loss_pct_baseline = median(median_loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_pct_baseline = median(q90_loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
      participants_ge50 = paste(sort(unique(as.character(participant[participant_pass_50]))), collapse = ","),
      participants_ge75 = paste(sort(unique(as.character(participant[participant_pass_75]))), collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rank_exact_summary()
}

exact_participant_summary_all <- make_exact_participant_summary(cca_scored_light)

exact_cell_summary_all <- cca_scored_light %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    n_participants_cell = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels_cell = n_distinct(channel),
    pct_cells_as_well = 100 * mean(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_cells_better = 100 * mean(better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_cells_same = 100 * mean(practically_same, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_cells_worse = 100 * mean(worse_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cell_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_cell_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_cell_loss_pct_baseline = median(loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_cell_loss_pct_baseline = safe_q(loss_pct_baseline, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

exact_summary_all <- make_exact_summary_from_participant(exact_participant_summary_all) %>%
  left_join(
    exact_cell_summary_all,
    by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
  )

exact_channel_summary_all <- cca_scored_light %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, channel) %>%

    n_participants_as_well = sum(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_participants_as_well = 100 * mean(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_loss_pct_baseline = median(loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Main exact-combination bar plot

Bars show the median participant-level percentage of EEG channels not meaningfully worse than full 15. Error bars show participant IQR. Text shows the number of participants for whom the combination worked in at least 50% of EEG channels.

```{r plot-main-top-exact, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
plot_exact_top <- exact_summary_all %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  slice_head(n = settings$top_exact_n_for_plots) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    support_label = paste0(n_participants_ge50_channels, "/", n_participants_total),
    plot_label = paste0(ecg_leads, "___", n_ecg_leads),
    plot_rank = n_ecg_leads * 100000 + rank_within_n,
    plot_label = factor(plot_label, levels = rev(plot_label[order(plot_rank)])),
    label_y = pmin(112, pmax(median_pct_channels_as_well, q75_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE) + 4)
  )

p_top_exact <- ggplot(
  plot_exact_top,
  aes(x = plot_label, y = median_pct_channels_as_well, fill = n_participants_ge50_channels)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = q25_pct_channels_as_well, ymax = q75_pct_channels_as_well),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = support_label), hjust = 0, size = 3, family = fig_font_family) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  facet_wrap(~ n_ecg_leads, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(n_ecg_leads = function(x) paste0(x, " ECG channels"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 115), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  scale_fill_cca_heat(limits = c(0, max(plot_exact_top$n_participants_total)), breaks = 0:max(plot_exact_top$n_participants_total)) +
  labs(
    x = "Exact ECG-channel combination",
    y = "Median % EEG channels as good as full 15",
    fill = "Participants\n≥50% channels",
    title = "Top exact reduced ECG combinations",
    subtitle = "Bars show median participant-level EEG-channel coverage; error bars show interquartile range"
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 55, 5.5, 5.5))

p_top_exact
save_plot_both(p_top_exact, "p3_top_exact_combinations", width = 12, height = 8)
```

# Participant- and EEG-channel top-20% validation

This section evaluates recurrence without splitting the data by dataset. For each participant and for each EEG channel separately, exact ECG-channel combinations are ranked within each ECG-channel count, and the top 20% pool is identified. The bar plot shows how often each exact combination recurs in those unit-specific top-20% pools.

```{r participant-channel-top20-validation, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
participant_total <- n_distinct(exact_participant_summary_all$participant)
channel_total <- n_distinct(exact_channel_summary_all$channel)

participant_exact_ranked_top20 <- exact_participant_summary_all %>%
  group_by(participant, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(pct_channels_as_well),
    median_loss_sesoi_units,
    q90_loss_sesoi_units,
    ecg_leads,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_rank = row_number(),
    top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    in_top20 = unit_rank <= top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

channel_exact_ranked_top20 <- exact_channel_summary_all %>%
  group_by(channel, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(pct_participants_as_well),
    median_loss_sesoi_units,
    q90_loss_sesoi_units,
    ecg_leads,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_rank = row_number(),
    top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    in_top20 = unit_rank <= top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

participant_top20_exact_frequency <- participant_exact_ranked_top20 %>%
  filter(in_top20) %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    validation_level = "Participant-specific top 20%",
    n_units_in_top20 = n_distinct(participant),
    n_units_total = participant_total,
    pct_units_in_top20 = 100 * n_units_in_top20 / n_units_total,
    median_rank_when_top20 = median(unit_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_performance_when_top20 = median(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_when_top20 = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

channel_top20_exact_frequency <- channel_exact_ranked_top20 %>%
  filter(in_top20) %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    validation_level = "EEG-channel-specific top 20%",
    n_units_in_top20 = n_distinct(channel),
    n_units_total = channel_total,
    pct_units_in_top20 = 100 * n_units_in_top20 / n_units_total,
    median_rank_when_top20 = median(unit_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_performance_when_top20 = median(pct_participants_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_when_top20 = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

validation_top20_exact_frequency <- bind_rows(
  participant_top20_exact_frequency,
  channel_top20_exact_frequency
) %>%
  arrange(
    validation_level,
    n_ecg_leads,
    desc(pct_units_in_top20),
    median_rank_when_top20,
    ecg_leads
  )

validation_frequency_plot_data <- validation_top20_exact_frequency %>%
  group_by(validation_level, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  slice_head(n = settings$top_exact_n_for_plots) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    validation_level = factor(
      validation_level,
      levels = c("Participant-specific top 20%", "EEG-channel-specific top 20%")
    ),
    plot_label = paste0(ecg_leads, "___", validation_level, "___", n_ecg_leads),
    plot_rank = pct_units_in_top20 + 0.001 * (1000 - median_rank_when_top20),
    plot_label = reorder(plot_label, plot_rank)
  )

p_validation_top20_frequency <- ggplot(
  validation_frequency_plot_data,
  aes(x = plot_label, y = pct_units_in_top20, fill = validation_level)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n_units_in_top20, "/", n_units_total)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.7,
    family = fig_font_family
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  facet_grid(validation_level ~ n_ecg_leads, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", labeller = labeller(n_ecg_leads = function(x) paste0(x, " ECG channels"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 108), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = validation_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Exact ECG-channel combination",
    y = "% validation units where combination is in the top 20%",
    fill = "Validation level",
    title = "Exact ECG-channel recurrence in participant- and EEG-channel-specific top-20% pools",
    subtitle = "Text shows validation units with the combination in their top 20%; cutoff is recalculated within each ECG-channel count"
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 55, 5.5, 5.5))

manifest[["10_participant_exact_ranked_top20"]] <- save_table(participant_exact_ranked_top20, "10_participant_exact_ranked_top20", csv = FALSE)
manifest[["11_channel_exact_ranked_top20"]] <- save_table(channel_exact_ranked_top20, "11_channel_exact_ranked_top20", csv = FALSE)
manifest[["12_validation_top20_exact_frequency"]] <- save_table(validation_top20_exact_frequency, "12_validation_top20_exact_frequency")

kable_clean(validation_top20_exact_frequency %>% group_by(validation_level, n_ecg_leads) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% ungroup(), digits = 2)
p_validation_top20_frequency
save_plot_both(p_validation_top20_frequency, "p3_validation_top20_exact_frequency", width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r participant-channel-robustness-5ecgchannels, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
top5_ecg_channel_candidates <- exact_summary_all %>%
```

# Participant- and channel-level top-20% recurrence

The display plots above may show 5 or 10 candidates, but the recurrence rule here always uses the top `r params$top_prop_main * 100`% within each ECG-channel count.

```{r bootstrap-top20-recurrence, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
rank_boot_summary <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    arrange(
      n_ecg_leads,
      desc(median_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(mean_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(q25_pct_channels_as_well),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units,
      median_loss_sesoi_units,
      ecg_leads
    ) %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
    mutate(
      boot_rank = row_number(),
      top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
      in_top20 = boot_rank <= top20_cutoff
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

rank_channel_boot_summary <- function(channel_summary) {
  channel_summary %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct_channels_as_well = mean(pct_participants_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_channels_as_well = median(pct_participants_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_participants_as_well, 0.25),
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rank_boot_summary()
}

stability_candidates <- exact_summary_all %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  slice_head(n = settings$top_exact_n_for_plots) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, original_rank = rank_within_n)

run_participant_boot_once <- function(b, participant_summary, participants, candidates) {
  sampled_participants <- tibble(
    participant = sample(participants, size = length(participants), replace = TRUE),
    draw_id = seq_along(participants)
  )
  
  boot_summary <- sampled_participants %>%
    left_join(participant_summary, by = "participant", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct_channels_as_well = mean(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_channels_as_well = median(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_channels_as_well, 0.25),
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rank_boot_summary()
  
  candidate_ranks <- boot_summary %>%
    semi_join(candidates, by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")) %>%
    transmute(
      bootstrap = b,
      stability_type = "participant",
      n_ecg_leads,
      combination_id,
      ecg_leads,
      combo_uid,
      boot_rank,
      top20_cutoff,
      in_top20,
      mean_pct_channels_as_well,
      median_pct_channels_as_well,
      q25_pct_channels_as_well,
      median_loss_sesoi_units,
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units
    )
  
  top20_hits <- boot_summary %>%
    filter(in_top20) %>%
    transmute(
      bootstrap = b,
      stability_type = "participant",
      n_ecg_leads,
      combination_id,
      ecg_leads,
      combo_uid,
      boot_rank,
      top20_cutoff
    )
  
  list(candidate_ranks = candidate_ranks, top20_hits = top20_hits)
}

run_channel_boot_once <- function(b, channel_summary, channels, candidates) {
  sampled_channels <- tibble(
    channel = sample(channels, size = length(channels), replace = TRUE),
    draw_id = seq_along(channels)
  )
  
  boot_summary <- sampled_channels %>%
    left_join(channel_summary, by = "channel", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    rank_channel_boot_summary()
  
  candidate_ranks <- boot_summary %>%
    semi_join(candidates, by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")) %>%
    transmute(
      bootstrap = b,
      stability_type = "channel",
      n_ecg_leads,
      combination_id,
      ecg_leads,
      combo_uid,
      boot_rank,
      top20_cutoff,
      in_top20,
      mean_pct_channels_as_well,
      median_pct_channels_as_well,
      q25_pct_channels_as_well,
      median_loss_sesoi_units,
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units
    )
  
  top20_hits <- boot_summary %>%
    filter(in_top20) %>%
    transmute(
      bootstrap = b,
      stability_type = "channel",
      n_ecg_leads,
      combination_id,
      ecg_leads,
      combo_uid,
      boot_rank,
      top20_cutoff
    )
  
  list(candidate_ranks = candidate_ranks, top20_hits = top20_hits)
}

bootstrap_candidate_summary_all <- tibble()
bootstrap_top20_exact_frequency <- tibble()
bootstrap_candidate_ranks_all <- tibble()
bootstrap_top20_hits_all <- tibble()

if (isTRUE(settings$run_bootstrap)) {
  set.seed(settings$bootstrap_seed)
  participants_all <- sort(unique(exact_participant_summary_all$participant))
  channels_all <- sort(unique(exact_channel_summary_all$channel))
  
  participant_boot_list <- map(
    seq_len(settings$n_boot),

  )
  
  channel_boot_list <- map(
    seq_len(settings$n_boot),

    channel_summary = exact_channel_summary_all,
    channels = channels_all,
    candidates = stability_candidates
  )
  
  bootstrap_candidate_ranks_all <- bind_rows(
    map_dfr(participant_boot_list, "candidate_ranks"),
    map_dfr(channel_boot_list, "candidate_ranks")
  )
  
  bootstrap_top20_hits_all <- bind_rows(
    map_dfr(participant_boot_list, "top20_hits"),
    map_dfr(channel_boot_list, "top20_hits")
  )
  
  rm(participant_boot_list, channel_boot_list)
  gc()
  
  bootstrap_candidate_summary_all <- bootstrap_candidate_ranks_all %>%
    left_join(stability_candidates, by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")) %>%
    group_by(stability_type, n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, original_rank) %>%
    summarise(
      n_boot = n_distinct(bootstrap),
      median_boot_rank = median(boot_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_boot_rank = safe_q(boot_rank, 0.25),
      q75_boot_rank = safe_q(boot_rank, 0.75),
      q90_boot_rank = safe_q(boot_rank, 0.90),
      median_top20_cutoff = median(top20_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_boot_top20 = 100 * mean(in_top20, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_boot_top10 = 100 * mean(boot_rank <= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_boot_median_pct_channels_as_well = median(median_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_boot_q25_pct_channels_as_well = median(q25_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(n_ecg_leads, original_rank, stability_type)
  
  bootstrap_top20_exact_frequency <- bootstrap_top20_hits_all %>%
    group_by(stability_type, n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_boot_in_top20 = n_distinct(bootstrap),
      pct_boot_in_top20 = 100 * n_boot_in_top20 / settings$n_boot,
      median_boot_rank_when_in_top20 = median(boot_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_top20_cutoff = median(top20_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      exact_summary_all %>% select(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, original_rank = rank_within_n, median_pct_channels_as_well, median_loss_sesoi_units),
      by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
    ) %>%
    arrange(stability_type, n_ecg_leads, desc(pct_boot_in_top20), original_rank)
}
```

# Exact recurring subsets among top sets

This section asks which exact lower-dimensional ECG subsets recur inside the top 20% parent combinations. For example, among top 5-channel combinations, it checks recurring 4-, 3-, 2-, and 1-channel cores. Enrichment is computed relative to how often that subset would occur among all possible parent combinations of the same size.

```{r recurring-subsets}
make_subset_strings <- function(ecg_leads, subset_size = 1) {
  leads <- as.integer(strsplit(as.character(ecg_leads), ",")[[1]])
  leads <- sort(unique(leads))
  if (length(leads) < subset_size) return(character())
  combn(leads, subset_size, FUN = function(z) paste(z, collapse = ","), simplify = TRUE)
}

make_ecg_lookup_basic <- function() {
  if (exists("ecg15_channel_lookup")) {
    return(ecg15_channel_lookup)
  }
  tibble(
    ecg_lead = 1:15,
    lead_label = c(
      "right_front_neck", "left_front_neck", "right_supraclavicular", "left_supraclavicular",
      "right_back_neck", "left_back_neck", "RA", "LA", "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "LL"
    ),
    electrode_group = c(
      "neck", "neck", "supraclavicular", "supraclavicular", "neck", "neck",
      "standard_limb_electrode", "standard_limb_electrode", rep("standard_chest_lead", 6), "standard_limb_electrode"
    )
  )
}

ecg_lookup_basic <- make_ecg_lookup_basic()

label_subset <- function(subset_string, lookup = ecg_lookup_basic) {
  leads <- as.integer(strsplit(as.character(subset_string), ",")[[1]])
  labels <- lookup$lead_label[match(leads, lookup$ecg_lead)]
  paste(labels, collapse = ",")
}

annotate_subset_basic <- function(subset_string, lookup = ecg_lookup_basic) {
  leads <- as.integer(strsplit(as.character(subset_string), ",")[[1]])
  subset_size <- length(leads)
  groups <- lookup$electrode_group[match(leads, lookup$ecg_lead)]
  n_v <- sum(groups == "standard_chest_lead", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_neck <- sum(groups == "neck", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_supra <- sum(groups == "supraclavicular", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_upper_vascular <- n_neck + n_supra
  n_standard_limb <- sum(groups == "standard_limb_electrode", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  contains_V <- n_v > 0
  contains_upper_vascular <- n_upper_vascular > 0
  contains_standard_limb <- n_standard_limb > 0
  contains_limb_axis_or_like <- n_standard_limb >= 2
  mostly_v <- n_v >= ceiling(0.60 * subset_size)
  mostly_upper_vascular <- n_upper_vascular >= ceiling(0.60 * subset_size)
  
  subset_family <- assign_anatomical_family_exclusive(
    n_total = subset_size,
    n_V = n_v,
    n_upper_vascular = n_upper_vascular,
    n_standard_limb = n_standard_limb,
    contains_V = contains_V,
    contains_upper_vascular = contains_upper_vascular,
    contains_standard_limb = contains_standard_limb
  )
  
  tibble(
    subset = subset_string,
    subset_labels = label_subset(subset_string, lookup),
    subset_size = subset_size,
    n_V = n_v,
    n_neck = n_neck,
    n_supraclavicular = n_supra,
    n_upper_vascular = n_upper_vascular,
    n_standard_limb = n_standard_limb,
    contains_V = contains_V,
    contains_neck = n_neck > 0,
    contains_supraclavicular = n_supra > 0,
    contains_upper_vascular = contains_upper_vascular,
    contains_standard_limb = contains_standard_limb,
    contains_limb_axis_or_like = contains_limb_axis_or_like,
    subset_family = factor(subset_family, levels = family_levels)
  )
}

summarise_subsets_for_parent_n <- function(exact_summary, parent_n, top_pool_prop = settings$top_prop_main, total_n_leads = 15) {
  parent_data <- exact_summary %>%
    filter(n_ecg_leads == parent_n) %>%
    arrange(rank_within_n)
  
  n_available <- nrow(parent_data)
  n_top <- n_top_prop(n_available, prop = top_pool_prop)
  top_pool <- parent_data %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(rank_in_top_pool = row_number())
  
  subset_sizes <- if (parent_n <= 1) integer(0) else seq(parent_n - 1, 1)
  
  map_dfr(subset_sizes, function(s) {
    background_share <- choose(total_n_leads - s, parent_n - s) / choose(total_n_leads, parent_n)
    
    top_pool %>%
      mutate(subset = map(ecg_leads, make_subset_strings, subset_size = s)) %>%
      unnest(subset) %>%
      group_by(subset) %>%
      summarise(
        parent_n_ecg_leads = parent_n,
        subset_size = s,
        top_pool_n = n_top,
        total_parent_combinations = n_available,
        n_top_combinations = n_distinct(combination_id),
        top_share = n_top_combinations / n_top,
        background_share = background_share,
        enrichment_ratio = top_share / background_share,
        best_rank_containing_subset = min(rank_in_top_pool, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_rank_containing_subset = median(rank_in_top_pool, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_pct_channels_as_well_median = median(mean_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_pct_channels_as_well_median = median(median_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25_pct_channels_as_well_median = median(q25_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_loss_sesoi_units_median = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_q90_loss_sesoi_units_median = median(median_q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
        example_combinations = paste(head(ecg_leads[order(rank_in_top_pool)], 5), collapse = " | "),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        desc(enrichment_ratio),
        desc(top_share),
        best_rank_containing_subset,
        subset
      )
  })
}

recurring_subsets_all <- map_dfr(1:5, ~ summarise_subsets_for_parent_n(exact_summary_all, parent_n = .x))

subset_annotation <- recurring_subsets_all %>%
  distinct(subset) %>%
  mutate(annotation = map(subset, annotate_subset_basic)) %>%
  select(-subset) %>%
  unnest(annotation) %>%
  select(-subset_size)

recurring_subsets_annotated <- recurring_subsets_all %>%
  left_join(subset_annotation, by = "subset") %>%
  arrange(parent_n_ecg_leads, desc(subset_size), desc(enrichment_ratio), desc(top_share), best_rank_containing_subset)

recurring_subset_top_table <- recurring_subsets_annotated %>%
  group_by(parent_n_ecg_leads, subset_size) %>%
  slice_head(n = settings$top_subset_n_for_plots) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    parent_n_ecg_leads,
    subset_size,
    subset,
    subset_labels,
    subset_family,
    top_pool_n,
    n_top_combinations,
    top_share,
    background_share,
    enrichment_ratio,
    best_rank_containing_subset,
    median_rank_containing_subset,
    mean_pct_channels_as_well_median,
    median_loss_sesoi_units_median,
    median_q90_loss_sesoi_units_median,
    example_combinations
  )

manifest[["18_recurring_subsets_annotated"]] <- save_table(recurring_subsets_annotated, "18_recurring_subsets_annotated")
manifest[["19_recurring_subset_top_table"]] <- save_table(recurring_subset_top_table, "19_recurring_subset_top_table")
```

```{r plot-recurring-subsets, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
if (nrow(subset_plot_all) > 0) {
  p_recurring_subsets <- ggplot(
    subset_plot_all,
    aes(x = plot_label, y = enrichment_ratio, fill = top_share)
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(100 * top_share, 1), "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.6, family = fig_font_family) +
    coord_flip(clip = "off") +
    facet_grid(parent_label ~ subset_size_label, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
    scale_fill_cca_heat(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Recurring exact ECG subset",
      y = "Enrichment relative to all possible parent combinations",
      fill = "Share in\ntop pool",
      title = "Recurring exact ECG cores among top reduced combinations",
      subtitle = "Top pools are always the top 20% within each parent ECG-channel count; text shows occurrence share in that pool"
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 65, 5.5, 5.5), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
} else {
  p_recurring_subsets <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No finite recurring-subset rows to plot") +
    theme_void(base_family = fig_font_family)
}

p_recurring_subsets
save_plot_both(p_recurring_subsets, "p3_recurring_exact_subsets", width = 14, height = 10)
```

# Exclusive anatomical families

The feature labels below are mutually exclusive. This avoids the earlier problem where the same ECG combination could be counted in several overlapping anatomical classes.

```{r exclusive-anatomical-families}
make_combination_annotation_lookup_clean <- function(max_n = 5) {
  if (!exists("make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup")) {
    stop("make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup() not found. Source ecg_annotations.R first.")
  }
  
  ann <- make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup(max_n = max_n)
  
  if ("combo_leads" %in% names(ann) && !"ecg_leads" %in% names(ann)) {
    ann <- ann %>% rename(ecg_leads = combo_leads)
  }
  
  ann %>%
    mutate(
      n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
      combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
      ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
      combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads),
      contains_any_V = contains_any_chest_V_location,
      n_upper_vascular = n_neck + n_supraclavicular,
      contains_upper_vascular = contains_any_neck | contains_any_supraclavicular,
      contains_any_standard_limb = n_standard_limb_electrodes > 0,
      contains_limb_axis_or_like =
        n_Lead_I_like_pairs > 0 |
        n_Lead_II_like_pairs > 0 |
        n_Lead_III_like_pairs > 0,
      contains_V_and_upper_vascular = contains_any_V & contains_upper_vascular,
      contains_V_and_standard_limb = contains_any_V & contains_any_standard_limb,
      contains_upper_vascular_and_standard_limb = contains_upper_vascular & contains_any_standard_limb,
      contains_V_and_upper_vascular_and_standard_limb =
        contains_any_V & contains_upper_vascular & contains_any_standard_limb
    )
}

ecg15_combination_lookup <- make_combination_annotation_lookup_clean(max_n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    anatomical_family_exclusive = assign_anatomical_family_exclusive(
      n_total = n_ecg_leads,
      n_V = n_chest_V_locations,
      n_upper_vascular = n_upper_vascular,
      n_standard_limb = n_standard_limb_electrodes,
      contains_V = contains_any_V,
      contains_upper_vascular = contains_upper_vascular,
      contains_standard_limb = contains_any_standard_limb
    ),
    anatomical_family_exclusive = factor(
      anatomical_family_exclusive,
      levels = family_levels
    )
  )

unclassified_family_check <- ecg15_combination_lookup %>%
  filter(is.na(anatomical_family_exclusive))

if (nrow(unclassified_family_check) > 0) {
  print(
    unclassified_family_check %>%
      select(
        n_ecg_leads,
        combination_id,
        ecg_leads,
        n_chest_V_locations,
        n_upper_vascular,
        n_standard_limb_electrodes,
        contains_any_V,
        contains_upper_vascular,
        contains_any_standard_limb
      ) %>%
      head(30)
  )
  stop(
    "Some ECG combinations were not assigned to an anatomical family. ",
    "Check whether every ECG channel belongs to V/precordial, ",
    "neck/supraclavicular, or limb anchor."
  )
}

exact_summary_annotated <- exact_summary_all %>%
  left_join(
    ecg15_combination_lookup %>%
      select(
        n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid,
        combo_labels, combo_groups, combination_family,
        anatomical_family_exclusive,
        n_neck, n_supraclavicular, n_standard_limb_electrodes,
        n_chest_V_locations, n_upper_vascular,
        contains_any_V, contains_upper_vascular, contains_any_standard_limb,
        contains_limb_axis_or_like
      ),
    by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
  )

manifest[["20_exact_summary_annotated"]] <- save_table(exact_summary_annotated, "20_exact_summary_annotated")

# Overall top-20% exact family prevalence.
top20_exact_annotated <- exact_summary_annotated %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(rank_within_n, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    in_top20 = rank_within_n <= top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(in_top20, !is.na(anatomical_family_exclusive))

overall_family_prevalence <- top20_exact_annotated %>%
  count(n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive, name = "n_top20_family") %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  mutate(
    n_top20_total = sum(n_top20_family),
    family_share_top20 = n_top20_family / n_top20_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(n_ecg_leads, desc(family_share_top20), anatomical_family_exclusive)

# Participant-specific top-20% family prevalence.
participant_top20_annotated <- exact_participant_summary_all %>%
  group_by(participant, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_channels_as_well), median_loss_sesoi_units, q90_loss_sesoi_units, ecg_leads, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_rank = row_number(),
    participant_top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    participant_in_top20 = participant_rank <= participant_top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(participant_in_top20) %>%
  left_join(
    ecg15_combination_lookup %>% select(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, anatomical_family_exclusive),
    by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
  )

participant_family_summary <- participant_top20_annotated %>%
  group_by(participant, n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
  summarise(
    n_family = n_distinct(combo_uid),
    median_performance = median(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(top20_family_share = n_family / sum(n_family, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

participant_family_group_summary <- participant_family_summary %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants_total = n_distinct(participant_top20_annotated$participant),
    n_participants_with_family = n_distinct(participant),
    median_family_share = median(top20_family_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_family_share = safe_q(top20_family_share, 0.25),
    q75_family_share = safe_q(top20_family_share, 0.75),
    median_performance = median(median_performance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss = median(median_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_ecg_leads, desc(n_participants_with_family), desc(median_family_share), anatomical_family_exclusive)

# Channel-specific top-20% family prevalence.
channel_top20_annotated <- exact_channel_summary_all %>%
  group_by(channel, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_participants_as_well), median_loss_sesoi_units, q90_loss_sesoi_units, ecg_leads, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    channel_rank = row_number(),
    channel_top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    channel_in_top20 = channel_rank <= channel_top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(channel_in_top20) %>%
  left_join(
    ecg15_combination_lookup %>% select(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, anatomical_family_exclusive),
    by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
  )

channel_family_summary <- channel_top20_annotated %>%
  group_by(channel, n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
  summarise(
    n_family = n_distinct(combo_uid),
    median_performance = median(pct_participants_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(top20_family_share = n_family / sum(n_family, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

channel_family_group_summary <- channel_family_summary %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
  summarise(
    n_channels_total = n_distinct(channel_top20_annotated$channel),
    n_channels_with_family = n_distinct(channel),
    median_family_share = median(top20_family_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_family_share = safe_q(top20_family_share, 0.25),
    q75_family_share = safe_q(top20_family_share, 0.75),
    median_performance = median(median_performance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss = median(median_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_ecg_leads, desc(n_channels_with_family), desc(median_family_share), anatomical_family_exclusive)

manifest[["21_overall_family_prevalence_top20"]] <- save_table(overall_family_prevalence, "21_overall_family_prevalence_top20")
manifest[["22_participant_family_summary_top20"]] <- save_table(participant_family_summary, "22_participant_family_summary_top20")
manifest[["23_participant_family_group_summary_top20"]] <- save_table(participant_family_group_summary, "23_participant_family_group_summary_top20")
manifest[["24_channel_family_summary_top20"]] <- save_table(channel_family_summary, "24_channel_family_summary_top20")
manifest[["25_channel_family_group_summary_top20"]] <- save_table(channel_family_group_summary, "25_channel_family_group_summary_top20")

kable_clean(overall_family_prevalence, digits = 3)
kable_clean(participant_family_group_summary, digits = 3)
kable_clean(channel_family_group_summary, digits = 3)
```

```{r plot-exclusive-family-heatmaps, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
participant_family_plot_data <- participant_family_group_summary %>%
```

```{r additional-anatomical-stability-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Anatomical family stability under participant/channel bootstrap.
bootstrap_family_group_summary <- tibble()

if (exists("bootstrap_top20_hits_all") && nrow(bootstrap_top20_hits_all) > 0) {
  bootstrap_top20_hits_annotated <- bootstrap_top20_hits_all %>%
    left_join(
      ecg15_combination_lookup %>% select(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, anatomical_family_exclusive),
      by = c("n_ecg_leads", "combination_id", "ecg_leads", "combo_uid")
    )
  
  bootstrap_family_summary <- bootstrap_top20_hits_annotated %>%
    filter(!is.na(anatomical_family_exclusive)) %>%
    group_by(stability_type, bootstrap, n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
    summarise(n_hits_family = n_distinct(combo_uid), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(stability_type, bootstrap, n_ecg_leads) %>%
    mutate(family_share = n_hits_family / sum(n_hits_family, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  bootstrap_family_group_summary <- bootstrap_family_summary %>%
    group_by(stability_type, n_ecg_leads, anatomical_family_exclusive) %>%
    summarise(
      median_family_share = median(family_share, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_family_share = safe_q(family_share, 0.25),
      q75_family_share = safe_q(family_share, 0.75),
      pct_boot_present = 100 * mean(family_share > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(stability_type, n_ecg_leads, desc(median_family_share), desc(pct_boot_present))
}

if (nrow(bootstrap_family_group_summary) > 0) {
  bootstrap_family_plot_data <- bootstrap_family_group_summary %>%
    filter(pct_boot_present > 10) %>%
    mutate(
      stability_type = factor(stability_type, levels = c("participant", "channel"), labels = c("Participant resampling", "EEG-channel resampling")),
      anatomical_family_exclusive = reorder(anatomical_family_exclusive, median_family_share),
      n_ecg_leads = factor(n_ecg_leads)
    )
  
  p_bootstrap_family_stability <- ggplot(
    bootstrap_family_plot_data,
    aes(x = anatomical_family_exclusive, y = median_family_share)
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q25_family_share, ymax = q75_family_share), width = 0.2) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(stability_type ~ n_ecg_leads, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(n_ecg_leads = function(x) paste0(x, " ECG channels"))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(
      x = "Anatomical family",
      y = "Median share among bootstrap top hits",
      title = "Anatomical stability under participant and channel bootstrap",
      subtitle = "If exact electrodes are unstable but families remain stable, this supports anatomical aggregation"
    ) +
    theme_pub
  
  print(p_bootstrap_family_stability)
  save_plot_both(p_bootstrap_family_stability, "p3_bootstrap_anatomical_family_stability", width = 12, height = 8)
}
```
